name: dhoomketu
brief: Dhoomketu, the Firework Commander boss: a wiry, tall, lean military trickster villain, narrow shoulders, long thin legs, upright cocky posture. Muted dusky-purple skin, single head, sharp hooked nose, huge swept-up black handlebar moustache, thick scowling brows. Plum-purple turban with a brass band and a small round gold crest at the front. Long plum military frock coat to the knees with a high collar and a dark charcoal chest panel with small brass buttons, dark trousers, pointed black boots. A diagonal brass bandolier across the chest from shoulder to hip, holding a row of short cylindrical pink-and-gold firework tubes. Strapped on his back, a rack of exactly three plum rockets with gold pointed tips, angled up behind the back shoulder, tips rising just above the turban. His forward right hand holds a short brass fuse-lighter stick (portfire) upright at chest height; his left hand rests on his hip. No horns, no crown, no mace, no blue skin, no armour plates. Strict right-facing side profile, full body, standing.
subject: full-body
